title: Interactive How Questions Work showcase and unified Gemini fallback
body:
HOW QUESTIONS WORK ARCHITECTURAL SHOWCASE
- Added an interactive "How Questions Work" page (/how-questions-work) exploring Countrydle's hybrid question-answering pipeline.
- Features an interactive 8-step question flow graph with live sample questions, AST execution diagrams, and vector search retrieval inspects.
- Added dedicated navigation links under About in the header and footer.

UNIFIED GEMINI QUESTION FALLBACK
- Switched secondary RAG question fallback from OpenAI GPT-4o-mini to Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite across all game modes (Countrydle, Powiatdle, Województwodle, and US Statedle).
- OpenAI API usage is now restricted strictly to text-embedding-3-small vector embeddings.
